verdict: Lead flow is steady but expensive; strong reviews and call volume aren't being converted into tracked revenue.
diagnosis: This period delivered 40 leads at $211 each — above the $149 non-branded search benchmark and near the $231 AC-repair average.

signals.headline: 40 leads at $211 each
signals.detail: Meta spend hit $8,453 for 40 leads this period. Cost per lead runs roughly 40% above the non-branded search benchmark.

signals.headline: 27 new 5-star reviews landed
signals.detail: Google Business Profile added 27 reviews at a perfect 5-star average. Reputation is a real competitive asset right now.

signals.headline: 82 call clicks from Google
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove 82 direct calls and 80 direction requests this period. Local search is quietly your best channel.

signals.headline: $0 revenue tracked in pipeline
signals.detail: Every opportunity shows $0 value. You cannot judge return on ad spend until job values get logged in the CRM.

signals.headline: 464 link clicks, 40 leads
signals.detail: Roughly 9% of link clicks became leads. Landing page or form is converting, but volume is thin at 17 clicks per day.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Your cost per lead sits above industry average
benchmark.body: The 2026 HVAC blended cost per lead is around $104, with non-branded search averaging $149 and AC repair campaigns hitting $231. Your $211 sits in the expensive zone for the category.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Peak AC demand window is now
seasonal.body: Summer is when HVAC phones ring hardest and install calendars fill fast. Homeowners delay until systems fail in the heat, which compresses demand and drives paid competition up sharply.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Equipment costs rising across every brand
competitor.body: Multiple manufacturers announced 3-10% July 2026 price hikes on parts and equipment. Financing offers and maintenance plans are becoming the main lever competitors use to close bigger tickets.

recommendations.title: Fix revenue tracking inside the CRM
recommendations.detail: Every opportunity shows $0. Consider logging job value at close so you can see which ads actually produce paying customers, not just form fills.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads alongside Meta
recommendations.detail: Google Business Profile already drove 82 calls this period. Local Services Ads typically run $25-$75 per lead — worth testing against the current $211 Meta cost.

recommendations.title: Split the campaign by service line
recommendations.detail: One broad HVAC campaign can cost around 27% more per lead. Consider separating AC install, tune-ups, and repair into dedicated ad sets with matching landing pages.
